def shapes(z, name):
    out={}
    for n in [-1,-0.5,0.5,1,1.5,2,3]:
        out[f'{name}^{n}']=z**n
    for k in [0.3,0.6,1,1.5,2]:
        out[f'exp(-{k}{name})']=np.exp(-k*z)
        out[f'tanh({k}{name})']=np.tanh(k*z)
        out[f'{name}exp(-{k}{name})']=z*np.exp(-k*z)
        out[f'cos({k}{name})']=np.cos(k*z)
        out[f'sin({k}{name})']=np.sin(k*z)
        out[f'1/(1+{k}{name})']=1/(1+k*z)
        out[f'{name}/(1+{k}{name}^2)']=z/(1+k*z**2)
        out[f'1-exp(-{k}{name})']=1-np.exp(-k*z)
        out[f'log(1+{k}{name})']=np.log(1+k*z)
    return out
